title: HMW DNA Extraction Protocol for Ferns
author: Geferson Fernando Metz

steps.title: Collect and freeze spores
steps.instruction: Recover spores with sporangia into 1.5 mL microtubes, fill to one‑third of the tube and store at –20 °C until disinfection.

steps.title: Homogenize spores and heat
steps.instruction: Invert the tube 10 times, then incubate at 60 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Ethanol wash spores
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 70 % ethanol, invert for 20 s, briefly centrifuge, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Water wash spores
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL autoclaved purified water, invert, briefly centrifuge, discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Sodium hypochlorite treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 10 % (v/v) sodium hypochlorite (≈2 % active chlorine), invert for 20 min, then centrifuge at 5 000 rpm for 3 min (room temperature).

steps.title: Repeated water washes
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 1 mL autoclaved purified water, invert, centrifuge at 5 000 rpm for 3 min, discard supernatant; repeat this wash four times.

steps.title: Plate spores on BCD medium
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL autoclaved purified water, homogenize, and pipette the suspension onto a Petri dish containing BCD medium (MgSO₄·7H₂O 0.1 mM, KH₂PO₄ 1.84 mM, KNO₃ 1 M, FeSO₄·7H₂O 4.5 mM).

steps.title: Store leaf tissue for dehiscence
steps.instruction: Place frond material in paper envelopes and store for three days to induce dehiscence.

steps.title: Grind leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh 50–100 mg leaf tissue, grind in a liquid‑nitrogen‑cooled crucible and pestle to a fine powder.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat lysis buffer, aliquot 600 µL into a 1.5 mL microtube, and transfer the powdered macerate into the tube with a spoon or spatula.

steps.title: Add RNase A and proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL RNase A (100 mg mL⁻¹) and 4 µL proteinase K (> 40 U mg⁻¹) to the tube.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Invert the tube 10 times, then incubate at 60 °C for 20 min, inverting gently every 5 min.

steps.title: Add chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL chloroform : isoamyl alcohol (24 : 1), invert for at least 3 min until an off‑white emulsion forms.

steps.title: Phase separation centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 rpm for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate the upper aqueous phase and transfer it to a new 1.5 mL microtube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL chilled (‑20 °C) isopropanol, incubate at ‑20 °C for at least 1 h (overnight storage possible).

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 rpm for 5 min at room temperature and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add TE buffer and sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL TE buffer followed by 5 µL 3 M sodium acetate to the pellet.

steps.title: Add cold ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 120 µL ice‑cold (‑20 °C) 100 % ethanol and mix well by flicking the tube.

steps.title: Incubate at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Store the tube at –20 °C for at least 20 min.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 rpm for 15 min at room temperature, then carefully discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Final 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol, invert gently, briefly centrifuge, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet on the bench, tube upside down, for approximately 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 50 µL nuclease‑free water (volume may be adjusted as needed).

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using a Qubit® fluorometer with the dsDNA High‑Sensitivity assay (expected yield 500–1500 ng).

steps.title: Assess DNA integrity
steps.instruction: Run 1 % agarose gel electrophoresis to evaluate DNA integrity.

steps.title: Remove short fragments
steps.instruction: Apply the Circulomics® Short‑Read Eliminator Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions to eliminate short DNA fragments.
